parts.text: Which claim correctly names materials of this pencil?

options.text: Wood, graphite, and rubber are materials that make up this pencil.
Writing itself is a material the pencil is made from.
Only the rubber tip counts as a material; the wood and graphite do not.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Kavya looks at a wooden pencil with a graphite core and a rubber tip. She wants to name the materials the pencil is made from.

part_answers.answer: Materials are the substances used to make the object. This pencil is made from wood, graphite, and rubber; writing is not a material of the pencil.

teacher.key_rationale: A material is a substance used to make an object. Wood, graphite, and rubber make the pencil; the act of writing is not a material.
